 Order

This appeal by the claimant under section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act is arising out of the award dated 28.04.2022 passed by MACT, Aalot, district Ratlam in Claim Case No.34/2015 seeking enhancement of compensation amount awarded by the Tribunal.

Dinesh vs Raju Rajav on 14 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/149589919/
1 2.
The date of accident, negligence and the issue of liability are not in dispute and the findings recorded by the Tribunal in this regard are also not in question.

As per the findings of the Tribunal,
for the permanent disability suffered by the appellant, the Tribunal has awarded a total compensation of Rs.5,78,587/- along with interest.

The breakup of the compensation amount is as under:
 HEAD AMOUNT
Permanent disability -Rs.3,36,000/-

Medical expenses -Rs.1,97,587/-
 Pain & suffering -Rs.20,000/-
 Transportation -Rs.10,000/-
Special diet -Rs.5,000/-

3 . Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the Tribunal has committed an error in not awarding just and proper amount of compensation in the case as the amount awarded by the Tribunal is on the lower side.
The income assessed by the Tribunal is on the lower side considering the minimum wages prevalent on the relevant period.

The Tribunal has committed an error in not awarding any sum under the head of future prospects keeping in view the verdict of the Apex Court in the case of National Insurance Co. Ltd. vs. Pranay Sethi and others - 2017 ACJ 2700.

entities.text: National Insurance Co. Ltd. vs. Pranay Sethi and others - 2017 ACJ 2700
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Hence,
prays for awarding just and proper amount of compensation in the case.

4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the Insurance Company has argued in support of the impugned award and contended that the Claims Tribunal has rightly awarded the compensation amount in the case which does not call for any interference by this Court.

5. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
6.
After hearing learned counsel for the parties and going through the record, I find substance in the arguments advanced by the counsel for the appellant.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, the arguments advanced by the counsel for the parties and the evidence that came on record, in the considered opinion of this Court, the income assessed by the Tribunal is on the lower side which deserves to be enhanced to Rs.6000/- per month considering the minimum wages prevalent on the relevant period.
Apart from that, the appellant is entitled for future prospects at the rate of 40% as per the verdict of the Apex Court in the case of Pranay Sethi (supra).

Thus, the compensation awarded by the Tribunal deserves to be and is hereby modified as under:
 HEAD AMOUNT  Permanent disability -Rs.5,64,480/-
 (i.e. Rs.6000 40% FP x 12 x 35/100 PD x 16 (m))
 Medical expenses -Rs.1,97,587/-
 Pain & suffering -Rs.20,000/-
 Special diet -Rs.5,000/-
Dinesh vs Raju Rajav on 14 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/149589919/
2  Attendant charges -Rs.10,000/-
 Transportation -Rs.10,000/-
 -------------------
 TOTAL Rs.8,07,067/-
7.
Thus, the just and proper amount of compensation in the instant case is Rs.8,07,067/- as against the award of the Tribunal of Rs.5,78,587/-.
Accordingly, the appellant is entitled to an additional sum of Rs.2,28,480/- over and above the amount which has been awarded by the Tribunal.
8. In the result, the appeal is partly allowed by enhancing the compensation amount by a sum of Rs.2,28,480/-.
The enhanced amount shall bear interest at the same rate as awarded by the Tribunal.
The other findings recorded by the Tribunal shall remain intact.
9. The appellant has valued the appeal only to the extent of Rs.1 lakh and paid the Court fee accordingly.

However, for the remaining amount, the Court fee shall be paid by the appellant within a period of one month and thereafter the amount shall be released by the Insurance Company on receiving the certificate.

In case the certificate has not been filed before the Insurance Company up to a period of three months, the claimant shall not be entitled to receive the interest on the enhanced amount of compensation.
10. In the result, the appeal is allowed in part and to the extent indicated herein above.

(HIRDESH) JUDGE hk/
